title: Icarus: The Wings His Father Begged Him Not to Trust
description:
Every telling remembers the fall. Almost none remembers what his father actually said first.
#chronicleandchaos #greekmythology #icarus #daedalus #ancientgreece #mythologyexplained #hubris
A retelling of the myth of Icarus and Daedalus - the wings built from feathers and wax, the one warning ignored, and the sea that still carries his name - for adults who enjoy mythology, history and folklore storytelling.
tiktokCaption: His dad built him wings from feathers and wax. Then gave him one rule. He broke it. #icarus #greekmythology #mythology #ancientgreece
reelsCaption: The myth of Icarus isn't really about flying too high - it's about the one warning he didn't listen to. #icarus #greekmythology #mythologyexplained #daedalus #ancientgreece #folklore #history
